zh.summary: 从题目给定的初始钻孔继续执行方向和长度命令。每条命令结束后输出钻头坐标；如果这条命令经过以前钻过的点，则输出 DANGER 并停止。
topics: 坐标模拟：用 (x,y) 记录钻头位置，向右加 x、向下减 y。
集合查找：visited 保存已经钻过的坐标，判断新坐标是否曾出现。
路径自交：新钻孔经过旧钻孔的位置；不仅终点，整段路径都要检查。
steps: 用题图中的固定路径初始化已钻过的坐标：从 (0, -1) 依次走 d 2、r 3、d 2、r 2、u 2、r 2、d 4、l 8、u 2，终点为 (-1, -5)。模拟就是按命令逐步更新位置。
把每个已钻过的整数坐标存进集合 visited。集合是一组不重复的值，可以快速检查某个坐标以前是否出现过。
读取一条命令后，每次移动一个单位并查集合。逐单位检查整条线段，才能发现线段中途与旧钻孔相交。
把新位置加入集合，并走完本条命令。输出命令终点和状态 safe 或 DANGER；如果本条命令有任何位置重复，输出后停止。q 命令只结束输入，不输出。
zh.example: 样例 2 中，r 2 到达 (1, -5)，没有碰到旧路径。接着 d 10 虽然结束在 (1, -15)，途中会在 (1, -7) 穿过旧的水平路径，所以输出“1 -15 DANGER”后停止。
zh.correctness: 初始化时，集合包含题图中从 (0, -1) 到 (-1, -5) 的每一个整点。之后对每条命令，算法按顺序检查并加入所经过的每一个新整点。因此集合始终表示已经钻过的位置。若新位置已在集合中，就与旧钻孔相交；若一条线段会相交，它必在该线段经过的某个整点上，逐单位检查不会漏掉中途相交。算法走完整条命令后输出其终点，并在第一次危险命令后停止。
zh.complexity: 设 C 为输入命令总数，S 为初始路径和实际处理命令走过的单位步数。代码先读入全部命令，需 O(C) 时间与空间；每一步做一次集合查找和加入，平均只需固定工作，因此移动部分用 O(S) 时间与空间。总时间和空间为 O(C+S)，意思是工作和存储量随读入命令数及走过的步数之和增长。即使遇到 q 或危险后不再移动，预先读入的命令仍占空间。
pitfalls: 初始路径不是空的；必须先把题图中的整条折线加入集合。
向下使 y 减少，向上使 y 增加；向左使 x 减少，向右使 x 增加。
只检查命令终点会漏掉样例 2 这样的线段中途相交。
发现中途相交后，仍要输出本条命令的最终坐标，然后停止。
q 后面的整数没有用途；q 本身表示停止输入。

en.summary: Continue drilling from the fixed path in the diagram. After each direction and length command, print the drill's new coordinate; if the command crosses any earlier drilled point, print DANGER and stop.
topics: Coordinate simulation: track the drill at (x,y); moving right increases x and moving down decreases y.
Set lookup: visited stores drilled coordinates and tells whether a new coordinate has appeared before.
Path self-intersection: new drilling passes through an earlier drilled location; check the whole segment, not just its endpoint.
steps: Build the fixed path from the diagram: starting at (0, -1), follow d 2, r 3, d 2, r 2, u 2, r 2, d 4, l 8, u 2. It ends at (-1, -5). Simulation means updating the position as each move happens.
Store every drilled integer coordinate in a set named visited. A set holds distinct values and can quickly tell whether a coordinate appeared before.
For each input command, move one unit at a time and check the set. Checking every unit along the line catches a crossing in the middle, not just a repeated endpoint.

Add each new coordinate and finish the command. Print the command's endpoint with safe or DANGER; if any position in the command repeated, stop after printing. A q command ends input and produces no output.
en.example: In sample 2, r 2 reaches (1, -5) safely. The next command, d 10, ends at (1, -15) but crosses the old horizontal path at (1, -7), so the program prints “1 -15 DANGER” and stops.
en.correctness: At the start, the set contains every integer coordinate along the fixed path from (0, -1) to (-1, -5). For each command, the algorithm checks and adds every coordinate it passes, so the set always represents the drilled locations. A coordinate already in the set means the new drilling intersects an earlier part. Any crossing occurs at a point along the commanded segment, and checking every unit point cannot skip one. The program finishes the command, prints its endpoint, and stops after the first dangerous command.
en.complexity: Let C be the total number of input commands and S the unit steps in the initial path and processed commands. Reading all commands takes O(C) time and space. Each step performs one set lookup and insertion, taking a fixed amount of work on average, so drilling uses O(S) time and space. Total time and space are O(C+S): work and storage grow with the sum of commands read and steps walked. Commands read in advance still use memory even if q or danger ends processing early.
pitfalls: The initial path is not empty; add the full path from the diagram before reading commands.
Down decreases y, up increases y, left decreases x, and right increases x.
Checking only the command endpoint misses crossings in the middle, as sample 2 shows.
If a crossing happens in the middle, still print the endpoint of that command before stopping.
The integer after q is unused; q itself ends the input.
